description: This file contains functions and constants related to handling mentions in messages, including pattern derivation, regex compilation, mention detection, and text normalization.

methods.name: deriveMentionPatterns
methods.description: Generates mention patterns based on optional identity object containing name and emoji.

methods.name: normalizeMentionPattern
methods.description: Replaces backspace characters in a pattern with word boundary regex.

methods.name: normalizeMentionPatterns
methods.description: Normalizes an array of mention patterns.

methods.name: warnRejectedMentionPattern
methods.description: Logs a warning when a mention pattern is rejected due to regex issues, with caching to prevent repeated logs.

methods.name: cacheMentionRegexes
methods.description: Caches compiled regexes with cache size management.

methods.name: compileMentionPatternsCached
methods.description: Compiles mention patterns into regexes with caching and optional rejection warnings.

methods.name: resolveMentionPatterns
methods.description: Resolves mention patterns from configuration, agent-specific or global, or derives from identity.

methods.name: buildMentionRegexes
methods.description: Builds mention regexes from configuration and agent ID.

methods.name: normalizeMentionText
methods.description: Removes zero-width characters and lowercases the text for mention matching.

methods.name: matchesMentionPatterns
methods.description: Checks if text matches any mention regex patterns.

methods.name: matchesMentionWithExplicit
methods.description: Checks mention match with explicit mention signals and optional transcript.

methods.name: stripStructuralPrefixes
methods.description: Removes structural prefixes, timestamps, labels, and markers from message text.

methods.name: stripMentions
methods.description: Removes mention patterns and provider-specific mentions from message text.
